hedgeqp_i.rule: scipy 1.18 optimisers on the same problem (lsq_linear BVLS for bounds, linalg.lstsq gelsd for unconstrained and MIN_NORM, minimize SLSQP for equalities); every output within root_finding

hedgeint_i.rule: no outside library solves integer least squares; uncounted (exact rational enumeration is the oracle)

hedgemv_i.rule: numpy 2.5 linalg.solve on the hedge block (covariance input) and linalg.lstsq OLS with intercept (series input); hedge within root_finding; variances are arithmetic

hedgegreeks_i.rule: QuantLib 1.44 AnalyticEuropeanEngine delta, gamma and vega per instrument, then numpy 2.5 linalg.solve; quantities and before-Greeks within root_finding

hedgebeta_i.rule: no outside library; Hull's worked example (30 contracts) is a textbook check, not counted

hedgeres_i.rule: arithmetic only; no library model value, uncounted

_wave1.note: Floor is measured over the stage at release, error cases in the denominator (ruling I-2)

hedgecredit_i.rule: QuantLib 1.44 IsdaCdsEngine NPVs on bumped HazardRateCurves (CS01, buckets, JTD by the spec's own central difference), then numpy solve; notionals, book pv, CS01, JTD and hedge upfront within the case limit

hedgecorr_i.rule: QuantLib 1.44 AnalyticEuropeanMargrabeEngine delta1 and delta2, and BlackCalculator.vega (the Margrabe price as a Black price in the spread volatility, asserted equal to the engine NPV) for the vegas and correlation, then numpy solve; quantities and before-Greeks within root_finding

_stage.note: Stage I so far, error cases in the denominator (ruling I-2); the floor applies at release
